# Typography

Clean and legible first. Four open-source families (SIL Open Font License 1.1), each with one job.

![The brand headline scale in Readex Pro and the product scale in Noto Sans, with Arabic and mono samples](data:image/png;base64,)

| Family | Job |
| --- | --- |
| **Readex Pro 600** | Brand headlines: the website, slides, social posts and document titles. Never in the product's own screens. The wordmark is drawn from it. |
| **Noto Sans** 400 · 500 · 600 | Everything people read in the product: titles, body, tables, buttons, forms. |
| **Noto Sans Arabic** 400 · 500 · 600 | Arabic interface text, at the same size as Latin. A first-class face, never a fallback. |
| **Geist Mono** 400 · 500 | Codes, IDs, permission keys (`invoice:remind`), tool names, short uppercase labels. |

## Product scale (Noto Sans)

| Style | Size / line height | Weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title-page` | 24 / 1.25 | 600 | Page title (`PageHeader`), one per page |
| `title-section` | 20 / 1.25 | 600 | Section titles |
| `title-card` | 18 / 1.25 | 600 | Card, dialog, drawer and proposal titles |
| `stat` | 24 / 1.2 | 600 | Key numbers, tabular figures |
| `text-lg` | 16 / 1.5 | 400 | Reading pages, emails, onboarding |
| `text` | **14 / 1.5** | 400 | The default: body, table cells, inputs |
| `label` | 14 / 1.25 | 500 | Labels, buttons, tabs, table headers |
| `caption` | 12 / 1.5 | 400 | Hints, metadata, timestamps |
| `micro` | 11 / 1.25 | 500 | The floor: counters and tiny badges only |

## Brand scale (Readex Pro 600)

Steps of 1.25 from a 16px body: **49 · 39 · 31 · 25 · 20 · 16**. Line height 1.1 for the large sizes and 1.25 for the small; tracking −2% at 39 and 49, −1% at 20, 25 and 31. Arabic document titles use Readex Pro's Arabic design (E.35). Body text beside a brand headline stays Noto Sans. Documents use the title at 22 pt.

## Arabic

- Set at **100%** of the Latin size (decision 3.7a), in Noto Sans Arabic, with a taller line: **1.7** for body text and 1.5 for labels and titles.
- No letter spacing and no uppercase styles.
- **Western digits 0–9** in every language, for money, dates, codes and data, so amounts read the same in both.
- The name stays "Whity" in Latin letters inside Arabic text, isolated with `<bdi>` (Flutter: an LTR `TextSpan`).

## Rules

- **No 700** in the product, and nothing below 400. Hierarchy comes from size and 500–600.
- **Nothing a person must read below 11px.** 12px is the smallest body text (captions).
- **Letter spacing is 0**, except brand headlines (−1% to −2%) and short uppercase mono labels (+6%).
- **Sentence case** everywhere; uppercase only for short mono labels.
- **Tabular figures** for numbers in tables, money and times (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; Flutter `FontFeature.tabularFigures()`).
- **Line length**: reading text at most 68 characters per line; forms at most 720px wide.
- **One page title** per page, and no more than three sizes in one component.
- Never set the wordmark in live type: use `Lockup` or the logo files.

Files: `fonts/` (Noto Sans, Noto Sans Arabic, Geist Mono and Readex Pro 600, woff2) and `handoff/flutter/pubspec_fonts.yaml`.
